new_slots.name: Guyger age
new_slots.sentence: Guyger, 38, was convicted of murder in the 2018 killing of 26-year-old Jean, an accountant from the Caribbean island nation of St. Lucia, who had been eating a bowl of ice cream when Guyger entered his home and shot him.

new_slots.name: arrest delay
new_slots.sentence: Guyger was arrested three days after the shooting and was fired before her murder trial.

new_slots.name: sentence minimum
new_slots.sentence: She had faced up to life in prison or as little as two years.

new_slots.name: jury damages
new_slots.sentence: In 2024, a jury ordered Guyger to pay Jean’s family nearly $100 million in a federal civil trial.

new_slots.name: prosecutors request
new_slots.sentence: Prosecutors initially asked the jury for a sentence of 28 years.

new_slots.name: release date
new_slots.sentence: The BPP did not say when Guyger would be released.
